verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services company with a case-preparation platform, so a documented public API is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no such API: probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec and for llms.txt all returned 404. The docs describe only human-led case management and a document-upload and tracking platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
